items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Alfred, she was a smith. That's my Alfred when I went over there in 48. That's my...my band tickets.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. He was the last I heard him, uh...

I left him, Alma's brother's kid, and me. I got it all on the record date. Well, he was down in New Orleans, big chief, not long ago. This is me when I had a long come out of the hospital from pneumonia. Uh-huh.
What was the hospital that you are?
